caption: The drawing features a large, clear glass bottle positioned horizontally on a decorative rectangular base. Inside the bottle, there is a detailed model of a sailing ship with brown masts and black rigging, and smaller white and brown boats floating on a blue surface that represents water. The neck of the bottle is capped with a gray and white stopper. The base below the bottle is yellow with a jagged black and gray geometric pattern running along its side. The background of the drawing is plain with a light beige or off-white color. The objects are illustrated with distinguishable lines and shading, giving a sense of depth and dimensionality to the image.
title: Ship in a Bottle
